x: We also have a number of promising Juniors including Reg Chamberlain who got 2nd place in the Surrey Long Jump last year and we hope to see more Youths competing along with Colin Clair and Malcom Draper.
Malcolm Draper · 1st Middx. County Youths Javelin 175' 3" (Rec.)

In the youths' section, Malcolm Draper was all set to secure a maximum of 24 points, having already won the high and long jumps, and being the holder of the 'Chandler' Cup, should have won the 100 yds; there being no doubt about scoring top points in the javelin.
It was nice to see Malcolm Draper over Christmas. He tells me he has now left hospital and is convalescing - hopes to be home in about two months but unfortunately no athletics for a couple of years.
